newsitem.title: THAILAND: Amata-EGCO borrows 3.4 bln baht for power project.
newsitem.headline: Amata-EGCO borrows 3.4 bln baht for power project.

text.p: Amata-EGCO Power Co Ltd said on Thursday it would tap 3.4 billion baht ($136 million) of short and long-term loans for its Bangpakong power plant project in southeastern Chonburi province.
Amata said it signed a $100 million, 14-year loan with German industrial financing bank Kreditanstalt Fuer Wiederaufbau and Bangkok Bank Plc.
The power company said it has also secured an additional 900 million baht worth of short and long-term loans from Bangkok Bank for use as its operating capital.
The plant is due for completion in early 1998. It will have an initial capacity of 170-megawatt, rising to 370-megawatt by late 1999, the company said.
About 180 megawatts would be sold to state-owned Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand.
